data.hook: A clean navy Siux crew-neck for the walk to court and the chill after.
why: Siux chest logo in contrast blue
Easy layer for early-morning and late-night sessions
data.summary: The Siux Ovni is a simple, comfortable crew-neck sweatshirt with the Siux logo across the chest. A good warm-up and travel layer.

faq.q: Can I try the sweatshirt on before buying?
faq.a: Yes. Tap "Keep it ready for me to see" and we'll have your size at the front desk to try on.
At the club front desk, the same way you pay for court bookings. There is no online payment.

data.clubTake: Brand new. Sizes are limited, so ask us to keep yours ready.
